qa.verdict: BA spec is insufficient for implementation — 3 actionable defects found that will cause a dev agent to produce incorrect or risky output
qa.overall_assessment: The spec is directionally correct and technically grounded. All 11 file-location claims were independently verified accurate. The scope is tightly bounded to photo rendering only — no CSS token drift, no layout changes. However, 3 issues require fixes before handing to dev: (1) M10 renderCover() lacks a null-day guard that will crash when no days are loaded, (2) M11 CSS rule permits global img[hidden]/img:not([src]) selectors that contradict the stated 'component-local rules only' constraint, (3) S1 onerror handler is not explicitly extended to #trip-cover in M10. Two additional Codex findings (is_home guard, Google API key leakage) are out-of-scope for this cycle and not blocking.

findings.issue: M10 describes renderCover() calling _deriveCityName(_getActiveDay()) but does not guard for _getActiveDay() returning null. _getActiveDay() returns null when state.days is empty or state.ui.active_day has no match (state.js:675 confirmed). Passing null to _deriveCityName() will throw a TypeError at 'acc = day.accommodation' (state.js:703). This crash path fires when the API response contains no days or the page is in an error state.
findings.evidence: state.js:675 _getActiveDay() exists and can return null. state.js:701-708 _deriveCityName(day) accesses day.accommodation unconditionally. M10 has no null-day conditional.
findings.required_fix: Replace M10's renderCover() definition with an explicit null guard: 'const day = _getActiveDay(); if (!day) { img.hidden = true; img.removeAttribute("src"); return; } const cityName = _deriveCityName(day); const url = (cityName && state.images.city_covers) ? state.images.city_covers[cityName] : null; if (!url) { img.hidden = true; img.removeAttribute("src"); } else { img.src = url; img.hidden = false; }'. Add this to Edge Cases as item 9: 'No active day — renderCover() must guard _getActiveDay() returning null; hide and remove src if null.'

findings.issue: M11 states 'CSS additions are limited to .card-photo and #trip-cover component-local rules only' but the same sentence includes 'img[hidden] / img:not([src]) visibility rule' — which are global attribute selectors that match ALL img elements on the page, not just .card-photo and #trip-cover. This contradicts 'component-local rules only' and would affect any other img elements that might be added in future or that exist today (e.g., any img in #header or static elements added by other cycles).
findings.evidence: M11 verbatim: 'sizing (e.g., width/height or aspect-ratio), object-fit: cover, optional border-radius, and img[hidden] / img:not([src]) visibility rule'. The selector img[hidden] is global scope.
findings.required_fix: Replace the global selector reference in M11 with scoped selectors: '.card-photo[hidden], #trip-cover[hidden] { display: none; }' and '.card-photo:not([src]), #trip-cover:not([src]) { display: none; }'. Dev must NOT write bare img[hidden] or img:not([src]) CSS rules. Update M11 to read: 'CSS additions are limited to .card-photo and #trip-cover component-local rules only: sizing, object-fit: cover, optional border-radius, and scoped visibility rules (.card-photo[hidden], #trip-cover[hidden] { display: none; }).'

findings.issue: S1 defines 'img.onerror handler on photo elements: on load error, hide the img and remove src attribute'. M10 defines renderCover() which creates/manages the #trip-cover img but does not explicitly state the onerror handler applies to #trip-cover. A dev agent reading S1 literally ('photo elements' = candidate card and slot-selected imgs) may not apply onerror to the cover image, leaving a broken-icon risk on CDN timeout for the cover.
findings.evidence: S1 says 'on photo elements' — ambiguous whether this covers #trip-cover (which is a cover, not a 'card photo'). M10 mentions no onerror. Edge Case 7 mentions onerror for CDN timeout but does not specify which elements.
findings.required_fix: Add to M10: 'Apply the same onerror handler to #trip-cover: on load error, set img.hidden = true and img.removeAttribute("src").' Update S1 to read: 'img.onerror handler on ALL photo img elements including .card-photo and #trip-cover.'

out_of_scope_observations.observation: Codex flagged: '_writeCardPhoto(node, opt) vs _writeSlotSelected() helper contract could be clarified by splitting into _getPhotoUrl(opt) + _configurePhotoImg(img, opt)'. This is a refactoring preference, not a blocker — the spec's existing 'applies same lookup logic' wording is sufficient for implementation. Routing to observations ledger, not blocking.

Codex flagged: 'is_home flag not guarded — private homes could render a photo via images.pois lookup'. The target data (beijing-lijiang-dali) does not appear to use is_home in its option schema; no evidence this field exists in the v2 trip contract option objects. Out of scope for this cycle.

Codex flagged: 'Exposing normalized images.json may leak Google Places API-key URLs for non-target trips (e.g. gerardmer trip uses google_ keyed pois with API key in URL).' This is a legitimate long-term concern for multi-trip deployments but out of scope for this single-trip editor cycle. The spec already restricts normalization to {pois, city_covers} only. Recommend a future cycle to add an image proxy or filter google_ keyed entries.

scope_check.notes: Spec correctly targets only photo rendering. No CSS token changes specified (Won't Have explicitly). No layout column changes. No drag.js modifications. Scope is well-bounded to the 4 files listed. The spec does NOT expand to solve unrelated problems from prior cycles.

anti_drift_guards_check.notes: Won't Have section explicitly prohibits CSS token changes, layout changes, mobile changes, drag.js changes, network fetching, and fallback image search. Dev constraint in Contract C explicitly says 'do NOT invent fallback lookup keys'. M11 explicitly says 'no token changes, no grid changes, no mobile rules'. These guards are sufficient to prevent the CSS-only drift seen in Cycles 1-3.

ac_coverage_check.notes: 5 requirements decomposition entries map to 6 acceptance criteria (AC1-AC6). R1->AC1 (candidate card photo), R2->AC2 (timeline selected card photo), R3->AC3 (city cover), R4->AC5 (API response), R5->AC4 (graceful hide). AC6 (no layout regression) is an additional regression guard. All R entries have measurable ACs with GIVEN/WHEN/THEN structure and screenshot requirements.

technical_correctness_check.notes: Lookup key pattern 'gaode_' + name_local verified against actual images.json structure. _deriveCityName() call signature is correct. renderAll() extension via renderCover() is implementable. M8 'append before nameDiv' wording is implementable given selEl.innerHTML='' clears the element first — dev creates img before nameDiv. M7 null-guard for name_local is explicit. The two issues (F1 null-day guard, F2 CSS selector scope) are actionable fixes, not fundamental design errors.

codex_consult.feedback_summary: Codex independently flagged 6 issues. 3 are real blockers incorporated into this report: renderCover() null-day guard (F1), CSS global selector contradiction (F2), onerror not extended to cover (F3). 3 are out-of-scope or observation-only: helper refactoring recommendation (OBSERVATION_ONLY), is_home guard (out-of-scope), Google API key leakage (security observation for future cycle). Codex confirmed that M8 'append before nameDiv' wording is implementable (OBSERVATION_ONLY) and AC3 'first visible element' ambiguity is acceptable given the conditional AC precondition (OBSERVATION_ONLY).
codex_consult.feedback_incorporated: F1 (null-day guard in M10) and F2 (CSS scope contradiction in M11) directly incorporated as required_fix items. F3 (onerror scope) incorporated as minor finding. Codex's refactoring suggestion (_getPhotoUrl + _configurePhotoImg split) rejected as out-of-scope enhancement. is_home and API key findings routed to out_of_scope_observations.

summary.rejection_reason: 2 major issues in M10 and M11 must be fixed before handing spec to dev. Fixes are surgical: add null-day guard to M10, scope CSS selectors to component-local in M11, clarify onerror applies to cover in M10/S1. No structural redesign needed.

failed_criteria: M10 lacks null-day guard — renderCover() will throw TypeError when _getActiveDay() returns null
M11 permits global img[hidden] / img:not([src]) selectors contradicting 'component-local rules only' constraint

required_ba_changes.change: Add explicit null-day guard: 'const day = _getActiveDay(); if (!day) { img.hidden = true; img.removeAttribute("src"); return; }' before any cityName lookup. Add as Edge Case 9.
Replace 'img[hidden] / img:not([src]) visibility rule' with scoped versions: '.card-photo[hidden], #trip-cover[hidden] { display: none; }'. Remove the global selector language.
Explicitly state onerror handler applies to #trip-cover in M10. Update S1 to read 'ALL photo img elements including .card-photo and #trip-cover'.

refined_context.recommended_approach: BA should make the 3 targeted edits to the spec (M10 null guard, M11 scoped CSS, M10+S1 onerror) and resubmit for QA. All other spec content is verified correct and ready for dev.
refined_context.additional_context: Codex independently confirmed all 11 file-location claims as accurate. The data pipeline is sound. The spec's anti-drift guards are strong. Only these 3 surgical text fixes are needed before dev can implement safely.
